I will keep this small beans plot the way I can manage with my own money and hands. This plot is only a quarter hectare, so buying chemical fertilizer just for it is hard, and here many of us do not put much fertilizer on beans anyway, especially when cash is tight. I will use some compost or manure from home, plant better seed if I can get it in time, and rely mostly on family work because I save hired labor for heavier work on the bigger plots.
